page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g8i server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

This server configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned externally. There are no integrated GPUs. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable resource for predictable workloads without the performance fluctuations of shared-core options. The hardware profile is suited for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, microservices, and small-to-medium database hosting where dedicated compute resources are required.
